newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway long debt yields rise, short end steady.
newsitem.headline: Norway long debt yields rise, short end steady.

text.p: 1500 GMT -- Norwegian long debt yields continued to rise as investors remained nervous following the Central Bank's inflation outlook a day earlier. Dealers saw selling in the long end, although the market was mainly in line with German Bunds and the spread closed in one basis point. The near-end of the debt curve was mainly steady as the crown held against the mark at 4.01 crowns at 1500 GMT. One dealer said the long end had fallen sharply and there was a risk of stop-loss orders being set off. "We're afraid there's a further risk to the downside so we're not recommending to buy at these levels," he said.
* 2007 bond yield four basis points higher at 6.20 pct
* Norway over Bunds gap one point narrower at 25 points
* Three-month eurokrone one basis point higher at 3.52 pct
